decisions.decision: Remove the T-120 blocker. T-120 was dropped on 2026-10-08 because GoHighLevel stays. The S3 guide teaches the Tantra omni-channel campaign, so all three S3 slots come from Tantra. Steps: (1) s1-blog #2: run the Draft the Pillar Post prompt in Claude Code in Terminal on a demo engine file and capture it. (2) s1-blog #6: publish that pillar post to our own mirror (adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live), then capture it at 390px. (3) s3 #5, #13, #14: in the [email] test workspace, create two test contacts named 'Adi test' (tags 'attended' and 'not watched'). Set up send-in-contact-time-zone and the final newsletter-list step, then capture. If Chrome has no signed-in Tantra session, run tantra-frontend-v2 locally with seeded data. If that also fails, fold these three into T-115's existing usetantra.com sign-in ask; don't create a new one. Then re-crop for phones (T-257 rule), run check-guides and probe-guides, merge and push.
